topic: EU pre-disclosed countervailing duties on China-made BEVs
capture_method: curator-frozen extracts plus unadjusted market observations

extracts: The disclosure was procedural pre-disclosure, not a final definitive duty decision.
Intended provisional duties were BYD 17.4%, Geely 20.0%, and SAIC 38.1%, on top of the ordinary 10% import duty.
Affected parties had a comment window and the Commission could revise calculations before provisional measures.
China-made cars' share of EU battery-electric sales had risen from around 3% to more than 20% in three years.
The China-made category included vehicles produced in China by non-Chinese-owned brands.
BYD reported more than 3 million new-energy vehicle sales in 2023.
